name: case1
title: Case 1: neck to thigh
about: A real scan, segmented by TotalSegmentator into 109 structures, shown at its true proportions (350 by 671 by 228 mm). The volumes are counted from the segmentation's voxels. 18 structures run into the edge of the scan, so their volumes read low.
credit: Segmentation: TotalSegmentator. Scan and labels: TotalSegmentator training dataset v2.0.1, subject s0461, Wasserthal et al. (CC BY 4.0). Surfaces and volumes computed from its labels; colour is illustration. Not a medical device. Not for diagnosis.

groups.label: Heart and vessels
groups.about: The heart and the great arteries and veins that the scan shows.

groups.label: Abdominal organs
groups.about: The solid organs of the upper abdomen.

groups.label: Lungs and airway

groups.label: Digestive tract
groups.about: The hollow tube that carries food, from the gullet to the large bowel.

groups.label: Muscles
groups.about: The large muscles that the segmentation covers: those of the back, the hips and the groin.

groups.label: Ribs and sternum
groups.about: The cage that protects the heart and lungs and moves with each breath.

groups.label: Spine
groups.about: The stack of vertebrae, from the neck down to the sacrum.

groups.label: Skull and limb bones
groups.about: The skull, the shoulder and hip girdles, and the long bones of the arm and thigh.

groups.label: Kidneys, bladder and glands

parts.label: Heart
parts.about: A four-chambered muscular pump that drives blood around the body and through the lungs.

parts.label: Left atrial appendage
parts.about: A small pouch off the left atrium, lying against the front of the heart.

parts.label: Aorta
parts.about: The body's main artery, rising from the heart, arching over and running down in front of the spine.

parts.label: Pulmonary veins
parts.about: Bring oxygen-rich blood back from the lungs to the left atrium.

parts.label: Brachiocephalic trunk
parts.about: The first large branch of the aortic arch, which divides to supply the right arm and the right side of the head.

parts.label: Right subclavian artery
parts.about: Carries blood under the collarbone toward the right arm.

parts.label: Left subclavian artery
parts.about: Carries blood under the collarbone toward the left arm.

parts.label: Right common carotid artery
parts.about: Runs up the right side of the neck, carrying blood toward the head. Here it runs into the top of the scan, so part of it may be missing and the volume can only read low.

parts.label: Left common carotid artery
parts.about: Runs up the left side of the neck, carrying blood toward the head. Here it runs into the top of the scan, so part of it may be missing and the volume can only read low.

parts.label: Left brachiocephalic vein
parts.about: Gathers blood from the left arm and the left side of the head, crossing the chest to the superior vena cava.

parts.label: Right brachiocephalic vein
parts.about: Gathers blood from the right arm and the right side of the head into the superior vena cava.

parts.label: Superior vena cava
parts.about: Returns blood from the upper body to the right atrium.

parts.label: Inferior vena cava
parts.about: The largest vein, returning blood from the lower body to the right atrium.

parts.label: Portal and splenic veins
parts.about: Carry blood from the spleen and gut to the liver, to be processed before it rejoins the circulation.

parts.label: Left common iliac artery
parts.about: A branch of the aorta that supplies the left side of the pelvis and the left leg.

parts.label: Right common iliac artery
parts.about: A branch of the aorta that supplies the right side of the pelvis and the right leg.

parts.label: Left common iliac vein
parts.about: Drains the left leg and pelvis toward the inferior vena cava.

parts.label: Right common iliac vein
parts.about: Drains the right leg and pelvis toward the inferior vena cava.

parts.label: Liver
parts.about: The largest internal organ, which processes what the gut absorbs, makes bile and stores energy.

parts.label: Spleen
parts.about: Filters the blood and stores immune cells; it sits high on the left, under the ribs.

parts.label: Pancreas
parts.about: Lies behind the stomach and makes digestive enzymes as well as hormones such as insulin.

parts.label: Gallbladder
parts.about: A small sac under the liver that stores and concentrates bile.

parts.label: Left upper lobe
parts.about: The upper of the left lung's two lobes, which includes the part that wraps around the heart.

parts.label: Left lower lobe
parts.about: The lower of the left lung's two lobes, resting on the diaphragm.

parts.label: Right upper lobe
parts.about: The top of the right lung's three lobes.

parts.label: Right middle lobe
parts.about: The smallest lobe, found only in the right lung, at the front.

parts.label: Right lower lobe
parts.about: The lowest of the right lung's three lobes, resting on the diaphragm.

parts.label: Trachea
parts.about: The windpipe, held open by rings of cartilage, which divides into the two main bronchi.

parts.label: Esophagus
parts.about: The muscular tube that carries food from the throat to the stomach, behind the windpipe and heart.

parts.label: Stomach
parts.about: A muscular bag that stores food and begins to break it down with acid and enzymes.

parts.label: Duodenum
parts.about: The first, C-shaped part of the small bowel, where bile and pancreatic juices join the food.

parts.label: Small bowel
parts.about: The long coiled tube where most nutrients are absorbed.

parts.label: Colon
parts.about: The large bowel, which frames the small bowel and takes up water from what is left.

parts.label: Right kidney

parts.label: Left kidney

parts.label: Urinary bladder

parts.label: Prostate

parts.label: Right adrenal gland

parts.label: Left adrenal gland

parts.label: Thyroid gland

parts.label: Spinal cord
